'''Elekks''' are a species of large creatures native to the easternmost shores of [[Kalimdor]]. They are a rare, almost nomadic creature that would rather be in solitude than packs.<ref>{{questlong|Horde|57|The Mighty Elekk}}</ref> Though they are primarily known to be found along the [[Moonwhisper Coast]], they can also be rarely sighted in [[Ashenvale]] and [[Azshara]].<ref>[https://database.turtlecraft.gg/?item=37025 Baby Ashenvale Elekk]</ref><ref>[https://database.turtlecraft.gg/?item=37026 Baby Azshara Elekk]</ref>
